name: Code Change Verification
description: Run change-aware lint, typecheck, build, and test verification based on the files and stack touched by a code change.

operational.approval_boundary: May run local verification commands; require human approval before retrying destructive setup or environment-changing commands.
operational.use_when: Use when a code change needs stack-aware lint, typecheck, build, and test verification based on touched files.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
